_note: Editable planning defaults used by lib/sb4.ts. Every number here is a planning assumption, not a legal requirement, unless the note says it comes from SB 4.

sqftPerParkingSpace.note: Per kept parking space including aisles and drive lanes.

setbackPct.note: Share of gross buildable area lost to setbacks and site circulation.

townhome.note: Habitat townhome: 900 sq ft footprint over two stories plus a small yard; ~1,850 sq ft of land per unit once shared drive aisles are counted (about 23 homes per acre).

flats.note: Stacked flats: three stories of 850 sq ft units; ~750 sq ft of land per unit (about 58 homes per acre). Practical count is capped at 1.1× the SB 4 minimum to keep projects at Habitat scale.

peoplePerHousehold.note: Average Habitat OC partner-family size used for people-housed estimates.

affordabilityYears.note: From SB 4: ownership units carry a 45-year affordability deed restriction (55 years for rental).

defaultKeepParkingShare.note: Default scenario keeps half of today's parking spaces for the congregation.

landValuePerAcre.note: Illustrative assumption only: approximate Orange County land value per acre used to describe what a land partnership is worth. Not an appraisal.

density.note: From SB 4: minimum density in a metropolitan jurisdiction like Orange County is 30 units per acre, or 40 where the zone does not allow residential use.

sb4.note: Objective standards from Gov. Code § 65913.16 as summarized in the HCD SB 4 fact sheet.

brief.note: Figures quoted from the Claude Impact Lab challenge brief: $1.47M median OC home price, ~4 years from land to keys, 34 cities with their own forms and fees, a family can pay 30-35% of income.

gap.note: Illustrative per-home cost model for the 'Closes the gap' bar. Real numbers vary by site. None of these are appraisals or quotes.

designPerHome.note: Illustrative design and engineering cost per home.

permitsPerHome.note: Illustrative city permits, impact fees and entitlement costs per home.

buildPerHome.note: Illustrative hard construction cost for a Habitat townhome or flat (volunteer labour and donated materials reduce it).

carryingCostPerHomeMonth.note: Illustrative interest, insurance and overhead per home per month while a project waits for approval.

typicalMonthsLandToKeys.note: From the challenge brief: about four years from land to keys on today's path.

sb4MonthsLandToKeys.note: Illustrative assumption for a by-right SB 4 project: no discretionary hearings and no CEQA review, so entitlement runs in months, not years.

ocMedianHouseholdIncome.note: Illustrative area median income for an Orange County household (HUD 2024 AMI, 4-person). Habitat serves families in income tiers below this.

defaultTierShare.note: Default family tier used in the bar: 50% of AMI.

taxesInsuranceShareOfPayment.note: Share of the monthly payment that goes to taxes and insurance rather than principal (Habitat mortgages are 0% interest).

otherSourcesPerHome.note: Illustrative grants, donations and subsidy per home.

partnerLandPerHome.note: Partner land via ground lease or donation: the congregation keeps ownership; Habitat does not buy at market.
